messages:
maria (AE): Hey team — Cortex Health's procurement/security folks are asking for our BCP/DR specifics before signing. They want RTO/RPO numbers, backup cadence & retention, failover playbook, and any test evidence (recent DR drills + uptime metrics for last 12 months). Need a concise bundle to share by EOD PT. cc @jaime (SE) @sam (SRE) @andrew (CISO)

jaime (SE): Quick summary we can send: our hosted control plane uses primary region + warm-standby in a second region with automated routing. For inference: we route traffic to active region(s) and have automated fallback to secondary region within ~15 minutes under major region outage. RTO: ~15 min for API traffic failover (typical), RPO: for stateless inference requests it's effectively 0 (no queued state), for user metadata and job state we rely on cross-region DB replication with RPO ≲ 5 min. Backups: daily full snapshots of persistent stores, incremental hourly for 7 days, 30-day snapshot retention by default (longer on request). Note: Dedicated/Private deployments can have custom RTO/RPO depending on topology.

sam (SRE): Adding runbook + evidence pointers. We ran a planned regional failover test on 2025-10-04 — automated traffic cutover to secondary and sanity checks completed. Test result: success (no data loss, <20s request errors spike, <5% p50 latency bump). Artifacts: load graphs and postmortem at https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dr-tests/2025-10-04 (shareable excerpt available).

ops-bot: Scheduled DR test completed: 2025-10-04T02:10Z -> success. Noted: primary region isolation simulated, failover completed in 12m. Logs uploaded to /s3/redwood-dr-tests/2025-10-04 (access: restricted). :white_check_mark:

andrew (CISO): For security reviewers you'll want to include: KMS-backed encrypted backups (AES-256), customer-managed KMS option for Private, backup integrity checks, access controls for restore operations, and audit logs for all failovers. We'll redact internal IPs but include the SOC2 summary page and our continuity policy excerpt. If they ask about RTO guarantees attach SLA excerpt (hosted: 99.9% monthly uptime SLA; Dedicated: custom SLA in contract).

maria (AE): Perfect. Can someone paste a short 1-paragraph blurb I can send to Cortex Health now? Keep it non-sensitive and customer-facing.

jaime (SE): Pasteable blurb below (feel free to prune):

"Redwood Inference runs a multi-region continuity architecture for our hosted service with automated failover and routing. In typical scenarios we achieve API failover within ~15 minutes and protect inference requests as stateless operations; persistent metadata is cross-region replicated with conservative RPO targets (<=5 minutes) and daily snapshots retained 30 days. Backups are encrypted with KMS; customers on Private deployments may use their own KMS. We perform regular DR drills and can provide redacted test evidence and uptime metrics on request. For contractual SLAs, hosted customers receive a 99.9% monthly uptime commitment; enterprise plans can include stricter, bespoke SLAs."

andrew (CISO): That reads well. Two small edits: change "~15 minutes" -> "up to 15 minutes" and add "incremental hourly backups for 7 days" after snapshots.

jaime (SE): Updated blurb: 

"Redwood Inference runs a multi-region continuity architecture for our hosted service with automated failover and routing. In typical scenarios we achieve API failover up to 15 minutes and protect inference requests as stateless operations; persistent metadata is cross-region replicated with conservative RPO targets (<=5 minutes), daily full snapshots with incremental hourly backups for 7 days, and 30-day snapshot retention. Backups are encrypted with KMS; customers on Private deployments may use their own KMS. We perform regular DR drills and can provide redacted test evidence and uptime metrics on request. For contractual SLAs, hosted customers receive a 99.9% monthly uptime commitment; enterprise plans can include stricter, bespoke SLAs."

maria (AE): Thanks — I'll send that. Separate ask from Cortex: they also want a short checklist of artifacts (no sensitive details) we can share. Can we list 4 items?

sam (SRE): Suggested checklist (shareable):
- DR playbook (redacted) with failover steps and owners
- Redacted postmortem + test summary from last 12 months
- Backup policy summary (encryption + retention)
- SLA excerpt + contact for escalation (security@redwood.com)

maria (AE): Awesome — exactly what they asked for. I'll send both docs now. If they push for more detail, I'll bring in legal/security. Thanks all :pray:
